name: Aniyome Dakara!
source:
Tsuyoshi has a childhood friend, Sakurako. They love each other, but she never lets him make love with her. The reason is that she is going to marry one of his older brothers!? He is so shocked to hear that, and his sisters-in-law give him sex lessons...
